title: CODEX® Multiplexed Imaging Microscope Setup and Tissue Imaging
author: Diane Saunders
materials: Check and power up equipment: CODEX® Instrument and Keyence BZ-X810 microscope. Figure 1. Integration and configuration of CODEX® Instrument integrated with the Keyence BZ-X810 microscope.

Launch the CODEX Instrument Manger (CIM) software. Load or create an experiment template and input appropriate labels under Project , Experiment , and Operator fields. Instructions described here are based on CIM version 1.30.0.12; see CODEX® Support for more information.
Shut down BZ-X Viewer and CIM software.

Gather additional supplies: CODEX Gaskets v2 Akoya Biosciences Catalog #7000010 22 x 22m Glass Cover Slips # 1 1/2 Electron Microscopy Sciences Catalog #72204-01 Dimethyl sulfoxide ≥99.9% Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #472301-6X1L

steps.title: Prepare 1X CODEX Buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 100 mL of 10X CODEX Buffer with 900 mL Milli‑Q/ddH₂O to make 1 L of 1X CODEX Buffer.

steps.title: Fill Instrument Reagent Bottles
steps.instruction: Place the prepared 1X CODEX Buffer into Bottle 1, fill Bottle 2 with DMSO, and ensure the waste bottle is empty.

steps.title: Set Cycle Parameters
steps.instruction: In the software, enter the desired total number of cycles in “Total #Cycles” and specify the Start Cycle Well as the first well of the reporter plate.

steps.title: Verify Template and Z‑Stack
steps.instruction: Check the template for correct marker names, classes, and exposure times; set Z‑Stack Planes to 5.

steps.title: Prime CODEX Instrument
steps.instruction: Briefly soak a gasket in 1X CODEX Buffer, load a blank coverslip onto the stage plate, place the soaked gasket on top, fit and tighten the stage insert, position the assembly on a horizontal surface (plastic collection container or benchtop), and click “Prime” in the Experiment Start Wizard.

steps.title: Load Sample Coverslip
steps.instruction: After priming completes, discard the blank coverslip, load the sample coverslip onto the stage plate, place a fresh gasket on top, tighten the stage insert, wipe the bottom of the coverslip with a water‑dipped Kimwipe, and insert the stage plate/insert into the Keyence BZ‑X810 microscope holder ensuring fluidic lines exit the front.

steps.title: Add DAPI Nuclear Stain
steps.instruction: Pipette 700 µL of Nuclear Stain Solution (0.067 % v/v nuclear stain in 1X CODEX Buffer) onto the sample coverslip and click “Immediately Wash Tissue” in the Experiment Start Wizard.

steps.title: Start Experiment and Pre‑Check
steps.instruction: Press the “Start Experiment” button, select “Microscope Pre‑Check” in the CIM Experiment Start Wizard; if the check fails, re‑verify microscope parameters per the Quick Reference Guide, then press “Start Run” and remain for several minutes to confirm no well leakage.

steps.title: Configure Microscope Acquisition
steps.instruction: Minimize the CIM window, open BZ‑X Viewer, choose “Capture Still Images”, set Sample Holder to “Versatile”, and enable Multi‑Color for DAPI, GFP, TRITC, and Cy5 channels.

steps.title: Set Channel and Image Options
steps.instruction: Set all channel pseudocolors to white, Excitation Light to 100 % with Low Photobleach, camera to Mono, Resolution Sensitivity to High Resolution. In the Options tab enable Z‑Stack → Multi‑Color, enable Gain, Transmitted Light Power, and Excitation Light Filter; select 14‑bit TIFF, enable Automatic Save as TIFF.

steps.title: Define Capture Area Settings
steps.instruction: Enable Z‑Stack, enter a Pitch of 1.5 µm, enable Stitching, and choose “Set Center and Number of Images”.

steps.title: Set Z‑Stack Focus
steps.instruction: Using BZ‑X Viewer, ensure tissue is over the objective, switch to DAPI channel, perform autofocus at multiple points, record Z positions; if positions are within ~5 µm, scroll to the central Z, select “Fix Range” in Capture Area Settings and set range to 5 images (~6 µm). If not, clean the coverslip underside, verify stage insert security, and increase Range and Z‑Stack planes as needed.

steps.title: Define Imaging Region
steps.instruction: Open the Navigation window, add regions to cover tissue edges, use macro‑stitched images to locate the tissue centre, set the number of X and Y tiles under Capture Area Settings, verify the green capture box encloses the tissue, delete extraneous regions, then select “Start Capture” and specify a folder matching the experiment name as the file path.

steps.title: Capture Images and Stop
steps.instruction: Begin image acquisition, press Stop after a few images, ensuring data are saved.

steps.title: Post‑Run Coverslip Handling
steps.instruction: After the run, carefully remove the coverslip; if further imaging or staining is planned, place it in Storage Buffer at 4 °C, otherwise discard.

steps.title: Clean Instrument and Perform Maintenance
steps.instruction: Load a blank coverslip and run a Clean Instrument Wash via the Maintenance tab. If no immediate subsequent run, place Bottle 1 and Bottle 2 lines in a beaker of Milli‑Q water and execute a Maintenance Wash.

steps.title: Empty Waste and Remove Reporter Plate
steps.instruction: Empty the vacuum waste container and small solution containers under the hood, rinse them, and let dry on paper towels; then remove the reporter plate.

steps.title: Load Reporter Plate and Equilibrate
steps.instruction: Load the prepared reporter plate, noting the coordinates of the first well containing solution, and allow both the coverslip in storage buffer and the reporter plate to equilibrate to room temperature.
